faqs.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faqs.a: No prior professional programming experience is required. The masterclass is designed to help you understand how to build with modern AI tools. You should be prepared to learn, experiment, troubleshoot and work through technical challenges.
Yes. Beginners can join. The training builds from foundational concepts into more advanced product-building, AI agent, automation and deployment workflows.

faqs.q: Will I learn how to build SaaS products?
faqs.a: Yes. The masterclass covers the process and systems involved in building modern AI-powered web products.
Yes. You will learn the concepts and workflows behind agentic AI systems and how AI agents can perform multi-step tasks.
Yes. You'll explore how APIs, triggers, workflows, AI and external services can be connected to automate useful processes.
The AI ecosystem changes quickly. The masterclass focuses on relevant modern tools and, more importantly, the workflows and principles behind using them effectively.
Early bird is ₦50,000. After early bird closes, it becomes ₦100,000. Joining early saves you ₦50,000.
Yes. You will have access to all sessions.
After successful registration, you'll receive onboarding information and instructions for accessing the masterclass.
